title: Relocation
summary: The Heaven Defying Bead swallows the weakened fire beast king, perfecting its fire attribute and joining the already complete water attribute, while the enraged fire beasts break loose across the Fire Country. Wang Lin catches Sun Youcai again and gains a pseudo Earth Escape Technique and the Great Self Shura Technique, and chooses the escape technique. The fire beasts overrun the sects' seals and the Nascent Soul ancestors decide that all cultivators of the Fire Country will join a Fire Alliance and move to the Xuanwu Kingdom, leaving mortals to their fate. Li Muwan grieves for the mortals. Fleeing to the border, Wang Lin is caught up in the fighting and brought before the War Shrine Sect, where Feng Luan, Zhou Zihong's mother, reveals she knows his real name. Another War Shrine ancestor wants him dead for stealing Ma Liang's body, but Feng Luan takes Wang Lin as a registered disciple and gives him a Nascent Soul-grade talisman.

flags: The War Shrine ancestor who wants Wang Lin dead and calls Feng Luan 'junior sister' is unnamed (wiki EP16 debuts: Song Yunzhi, Yang Lin, Zhou Jin, Lan Ruo). 'Zhou takes the first step' (4:32) is probably Zhou Jin.
Feng Luan scolds her 'sister' (another ancestor) for sending Hong'er (Zhou Zihong) into the foreign battlefield (16:42-16:51), which shows Zhou Zihong is Feng Luan's daughter.
The episode's 'Waner' scene (9:44) is Li Qiqing talking to Li Muwan.
